title: Professional Certificate Course in External and Internal Environment for Designing Marketing Plan
description: Explore the intricate interplay between external and internal factors shaping successful marketing plans.
longDescription: Develop the ability to define and understand the components of the marketing environment. Acquire knowledge and skills related to implementing innovation in marketing strategies. Gain proficiency in conducting PESTLE analysis to assess external factors influencing business environments. Understand and apply the BCG matrix for strategic analysis of a product or business portfolio. Develop a comprehensive understanding of Porter’s Five Forces model for analyzing industry competitiveness. Explore the role of marketing in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives. Familiarize yourself with McKinsey’s Seven S Model for organizational analysis and strategic planning. This course provides a holistic perspective on market planning by examining both external and internal environments. From dissecting industry competitiveness using Porter’s Five Forces to strategic analysis with McKinsey’s Seven S Model, participants will gain insights into the intricacies of effective marketing strategies. courseDetails: Discover the nuances of the marketing environment with a focus on PESTLE analysis and strategic innovation. Dive into tools like the BCG matrix for product portfolio evaluation and explore the role of marketing in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR). This course ensures a well-rounded understanding of essential frameworks for designing impactful marketing plans.
